Dream 2026-11-22 linked 12 vignettes from 6 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-24 · retells · "tier0 vignettes to drive our understanding of our work" (Narrative explorations become the standard (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "In general we want to work meaning first, so problem and remedies allow us to understand the features we need to build" (Meaning first: derive problems and remedies from the vignettes to find the features (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "All problems and domains are evolved from stories" (All problems and domains evolve from stories (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Let's build a cannonical definition of our three axes." (The three lines and their poles are the creation myth: Wuji, Taiji, Yin/Yang, the eight images (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-28 · retells · "The problem and claim and remedy process - with domains and personas is an attempt to provide rich intent." (Are we missing clear intentions? Problem, claim and remedy with domains and personas give the intent autonomy needs (2026-10-28))
- 2026-11-05 · retells · "We pull out important fragments as vignettes... and then abstract records from that." (Raw conversation is provenance below the vignettes; we pull out fragments and export only the key bits (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "What we have done here is evolve a domain, or possibly create a new one." (Refining a domain is the essay process with a blueprint instead of a paragraph: the soup needs a tool to work through the underlying material (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "those vignettes will strengthen or weaken the assumptions we may have made about a topic" (A summary layer I can clone and edit; vignettes strengthen or weaken assumptions; I can only affirm in context, and a domain is our current best guess (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "we may find that our domains are just too simple at the moment" (Change in the editor is the user's own action, keep or try a new angle; our domains may be too simple (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "Affirmations are anchors. So are the vignettes. AI brings the coherence inbetween" (Affirmations and vignettes are anchors; AI brings the coherence in between, and affirmation is rarer than we expect (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-07 · retells · "we are not defining the domains with enough clarity to be useful" (Simple domains lack clarity to be useful; cells are relative to a boundary, divide and repeat; dream boundaries are valid if we know where they came from; cluster may stay a name for a boundary with a function (2026-11-07))
- 2026-11-07 · retells · "A cluster is probably just another boundary. Sometimes we sense them before we clarify them." (A cluster is just another boundary; sensed boundaries are clarified after, declared boundaries are held before looking inside (2026-11-07))
